resources.string: Light wind and no rain forecast: a good time to spray, sow or harvest.
Wind at %1$d km/h: the spray would drift away. Postpone the treatment.
Rain is forecast within 48 hours: let it water your plots.
Low of %1$d °C tonight: cover sensitive crops.
High of %1$d °C: irrigate early in the morning or late in the day.
